title: Unless: исключение без обратной гарантии
description: Unless: исключение без обратной гарантии: словарь, грамматическая модель и авторский текст с разбором смысла и объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Не приписывать правилу неуказанное обратное следствие
notes: В данном правиле unless вводит исключение: без указанного условия доступ закрыт.
Разрешение рассмотреть исключение не обязательно гарантирует доступ: читай остальные условия.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

public_payload.passage: The archive notice stated that nobody could enter the storage room unless authorised by the curator. The next sentence added that capacity limits still applied to authorised visitors. One researcher obtained authorisation and assumed that entry at any chosen time was therefore guaranteed. The curator explained that the exception removed one barrier, not every possible restriction. When the room was full, authorised visitors still had to wait. This did not make authorisation irrelevant: without it, they could not enter under the stated rule even when space was available. A faithful account had to preserve both the exception and the continuing limit. Reading unless as a promise of unrestricted entry would add an entitlement that the complete notice had never offered.

options.label: It guaranteed entry regardless of space.
It made the notice irrelevant to everyone.
It removed one barrier while capacity limits remained.

exercises.editorial_answer: It removed one barrier while capacity limits remained.
exercises.explanation: Исключение касалось допуска, но не вместимости.
